svg.title: Paracentric inversion: crossover and anaphase I
svg.desc: Stage A repeats the source four-chromatid inversion loop. Stage B shows two unchanged chromatids and the two reciprocal recombinant products, with source allele order, ancestry colors and centromeres retained. One recombinant is a dicentric bridge, the other an acentric fragment.
svg.metadata: Original editable schematic, created 2026-11-10. Source facts: genetics/LECT13/djot/assets/lect13b-chromo_alter_3-inversion/image_009.png; original ODP slides 6, 10, 12, 14, 16. Geometry newly composed, not traced. Unmeasured. Source labels and stage/copy counts preserved.

g.text: When the centromere is not included in the inverted region, one of the crossover products
is a dicentric chromosome, and the reciprocal product is an acentric chromosome.
Among the two chromatids not involved in the crossover, one carries the inversion and
the other the normal gene sequence.
